source: Sentinel Comics: The Roleplaying Game, Adventure Issues, Battle of the Bands (pp. 254–266)

scenes.name: Opening Act
scenes.notes: Standard 8-space tracker (2/4/2). Rockstar starts the concert with an Overcome on See A Million Faces.

environment.name: See A Million Faces
environment.description:
See A Million Faces (And Rock Them All)

Rockstar is on stage, along with any heroes willing to help out. The crowd doesn't care, so it's up to her to grab their attention and become a legend! (Ask Rockstar the name of the song she's playing.)

Action: On her turns, Rockstar attempts to Overcome this challenge. Other heroes on stage may use their turns to either Boost Rockstar or to attempt to Overcome. But be careful: upstaging Rockstar might have long-term consequences for team relations!

Resolution:

  • The crowd begins to warm up to the music.
  • Some dancing and headbanging ensues.
  • A stellar performance! The crowd cheers!

Outcome: When all three parts of this challenge have been overcome, proceed to the Conclusion. See the Scene 1 Conclusion for other end conditions.

Note: In the printed issue this is a challenge (not a full environment). Twists below are the Potential Twists from pp. 257. They are stored on all scene zones so the environment roller can find them regardless of tracker color.

minor.name: Guitar Strings Snap
minor.description: Reduce your Quality die by one size for your next Overcome attempt at the See a Million Faces Challenge.

major.name: Aggressive Hecklers
major.description: (H)/2 Moshers climb onto the stage to try to disrupt your performance. (H) always equals the number of heroes in a scene.

minions.name: Moshers
minions.description: These flailing dancers want more! They're climbing onto the stage! They're making a mess, and they don't have a lot of respect for the show or personal boundaries, apparently.

form.name: Thumpin!
form.description: Roll the minion's die when knocked out. On a 1, they got knocked down, but get back up again at a d4.

minions.name: Bouncers
minions.description: These large and strong no-nonsense club security staff are going to keep the peace at all costs. They're oddly focused on keeping the doors shut.

form.name: Quiet the Riot
form.description: Bouncers have +1 to all rolls to make Hinder actions.

scenes.name: The Headliners
scenes.notes: If See A Million Faces was completed, reset the tracker. If Scene 1 ended in disastrous failure, mark off the four leftmost spaces (both Green and two Yellow).

environment.name: Disrupt the Force Bubble
environment.description:
Disrupt the Force Bubble

A few tests determine that the cosmically empowered force bubble being generated by the drummer Snare is impenetrable to simple damage. However, that does not mean it can't be influenced.

As long as this bubble is active, Helfyre are able to feed on the energy of the crowd by playing their music! It's going to have to come down before something disastrous occurs.

Action: On a hero's turn, they may attempt an Overcome to shrink the bubble. Each success forces one member of Helfyre out of the bubble in the order below.

Resolution:

  • Screech
  • Drudge
  • Deep Root
  • Blister
  • Snare
  • Disable Cosmic Antenna (two successes)

Outcome: Completing the challenge by finally disabling the Cosmic Antenna ends the scene, as detailed in the Conclusion on page 266.

Note: In the printed issue this is a challenge (not a full environment). Twists below are the Twist Examples from p. 260, stored on all scene zones for the environment roller.

minor.name: The Power of Rock
minor.description: Boost one member of Helfyre still within the Force Bubble with the Min die.

minor.name: Sound Minions
minor.description: The Cosmic Antenna spawns (H) d6 Sonic Projections who attack the heroes. (H) equals the number of heroes in the scene.

minor.name: Audience Interference
minor.description: The crowd, affected by the Antenna, grab at the heroes, Hindering them with the Max die. (If the challenge from Scene 1 was completed, use the Min die instead.)

minor.name: Cosmic Channel
minor.description: The Cosmic Antenna produces extra energy, and one of the villains outside the bubble receives a +1 persistent bonus.

major.name: Heavy Metal Thunder
major.description: Boost each active member of Helfyre with the Max die.

major.name: Collapsing Cavern
major.description: The building begins to collapse. If the heroes don't put a stop to the performance by the time the Scene Tracker reaches the next zone, The Cavern will be no more.

minions.name: Sonic Projections
minions.quantityNote: 1 per hero (also spawned by Sound Minions twist)
minions.description: These ghostly energy beings seem focused on draining energy from the foes of Helfyre. They move in time with the music.

form.name: Conduit
form.description: Whenever a sonic projection damages a hero, one nearby member of Helfyre recovers health equal to the amount of damage dealt.

abilities.name: Earworm
abilities.gameText: When Attacked by someone with a penalty you created, Defend by rolling your single status die, and the attacker also suffers that much damage.

abilities.name: Ring their Ears
abilities.gameText: Attack using Sonic. Use your Max die. A target dealt damage this way Attacks an ally by rolling their single largest power die.

abilities.name: Scream of Anger
abilities.gameText: Hinder using Sonic and use your Max+Mid dice, or use your Max die and make it persistent and exclusive.

abilities.name: Shout it Out Loud
abilities.gameText: Hinder multiple targets using Banter. Use your Mid die. You and any nearby allies Defend using your Max die.

abilities.name: Blazing Axe
abilities.gameText: Attack one target using Fire. Use your Max die. That target cannot Defend or use reactions against this Attack. Attack multiple other nearby targets using your Min die.

abilities.name: Blistering Solo
abilities.gameText: Attack using Creativity. Then remove all bonuses from the target.

abilities.name: Burning Melody
abilities.gameText: Hinder one target using Presence. Use your Max die. Attack that target using your Mid die.

abilities.name: Sleep Now in the Fire
abilities.gameText: When Attacked with Fire, recover that amount of Health instead of taking damage. When Hindered with Fire, Boost yourself instead.

abilities.name: Stage Dive
abilities.gameText: Whenever your personal zone changes, you may immediately move elsewhere in the scene.

abilities.name: Bark Shield
abilities.gameText: When an ally is Attacked, Defend them by rolling your single Plants die. Boost yourself by that amount.

abilities.name: Can't Stop the Beatdown
abilities.gameText: Attack using Swinging. Either Hinder that target using Max, or Defend yourself using Min and you and that target end up elsewhere in the scene.

abilities.name: Photosynthestrike
abilities.gameText: Attack using Close Combat. Use your Max die. Recover Health equal to your Min die.

abilities.name: Plant Life of the Party
abilities.gameText: Reduce damage dealt to you by 2.

abilities.name: Writhing Flora
abilities.gameText: Hinder multiple nearby targets using Plants. Boost yourself using your Max die.

abilities.name: Drive the Beat Home
abilities.gameText: When a nearby hero that you can see invokes a twist, roll your Sonic die as a Hinder against them.

abilities.name: Encapsulate
abilities.gameText: Hinder multiple targets using Energy Shields. While a hero has this penalty, reduce all their power dice by one size.

abilities.name: Resonant Shield
abilities.gameText: When Attacked by someone with a penalty you created, Defend by rolling your single status die, and the attacker also suffers that much damage.

abilities.name: Switch Up the Timing
abilities.gameText: Select a nearby target. Either turn all bonuses on that target to equivalent penalties, or move a penalty from that target to another target that you can see.

abilities.name: Consume their Lifeforce
abilities.gameText: Hinder multiple targets using Infernal. Recover Health equal to the number of targets Hindered this way.

abilities.name: Enthralling Target
abilities.gameText: When Attacked, Defend yourself by rolling your single Presence die. If this negates the Attack entirely, Hinder that target and Boost yourself with that same die roll.

abilities.name: Feast on the Living
abilities.gameText: Attack using Close Combat. Use your Max die. Hinder that target with your Mid die. Recover Health equal to your Min die.

abilities.name: Immortal Form
abilities.gameText: When you would be Hindered or when an Attack would reduce you to 0 Health, reduce the penalty to -1 or reduce that damage to 1.
